answer: A work-slot deposit bond prices claimed tasks against fabrication. Each agent locks 50 credits per slot in a slow glacier escrow until peers verify it, with one horizon of open slots per identity. Ghost-slot farming fails: a fake result forfeits 50 credits and leaves a basalt record barring that identity for three epochs, so the k-th fake costs a 50 and 1,000 fakes burn 50,000. An honest agent pays one bond per job and recovers it on delivery.
